// diagnostic

E0911

A migration block uses a word that is not a migration verb

What

A migration block uses a word that is not a migration verb

Why

A migration block contains only `rename`, `add`, `remove`, and `change` operations

Fix

Write the operation with one of `rename`, `add`, `remove`, or `change`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0911: tests/ui/migration_unknown_op.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownMigrationVerb]: `frobnicate` isn't a known migration verb
  --> tests/ui/migration_unknown_op.jet:7:5
    |
  7 |     frobnicate x
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A migration block contains `rename`, `add`, `remove`, or `change` operations
 Fix: Use `rename old -> new`, `add f: T = default`, `remove f`, or `change f: Old -> New via { … }`
